newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sara Lee cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sara Lee cut to hold.

text.p: -- SBC Warburg analyst Chris Jakubik said Monday he downgraded Sara Lee Corp to a hold from a buy, noting the stock was up nine percent in March alone and gained 13 percent year-to-date.

-- "The view there is (Sara Lee) needs superior operating results or a strategic catalyst to maintain that momentum," Jakubik said. "I see little prospect of that in the near-term, particularly given higher green coffee prices and a strong U.S. dollar."
-- Sara Lee is a food and consumer goods company.
-- Sara Lee shares were off 1/2 at 41-3/4.
